frame_count_interpretation: 2000 total includes first 50 excluded warmup, leaving 1950 per main session (5850 primary). Extra sessions each 500 total, first 50 excluded, leaving 450 each. 7000 total / 6750 retained. All rows, including warmup, saved and flagged.

selftest.source: 100 consecutive actual webcam frames at session exposure after 12 discarded settle frames; excluded from timing, checked before session warmup
selftest.types: 9 numpy.float64 gammas plus Python float default 2/3; original reciprocal exponent preserved
selftest.comparisons: Exact dtype/shape/bytes: candidate RGB8 images, entropy/contrast/sharpness, brightness, NR-free/NR-mono and all four selectors. Independent original floating pipeline versus LUT path. Sequential and reset-to-default tie checks.
selftest.failure: First mismatch aborts entire sequence and writes diagnostic; no timing after failed selftest. No scene frames saved publicly.

quality_limitation: These sessions measure latency. The separate exploratory image-quality comparison is provided in realtime/camera_exploratory/.

timing.processing: Begin after capture returns, immediately before BGR->RGB and uint8 INTER_LINEAR resize 640x480 to 256x256; end after 9 LUT candidates, three features, batched NR-free score, original tie selection and full-resolution cv2.LUT. Tables/model loads precomputed outside loop. Capture wait/display/logging excluded.
timing.camera_interval: capture_end_ns[i] - capture_end_ns[i-1]. The warmup predecessor supplies interval for first retained frame. This is measured host delivery spacing in the live loop, not sensor timestamp or guaranteed source fps.
timing.deadline_miss: processing_ms[i] > camera_interval_ms[i], strict >; report numerator/retained denominator and percent. This retrospective comparison can hide back-pressure; do not equate zero misses with hard real-time guarantees.
timing.actual_loop_fps: N_retained / ((last retained processing_end_ns - immediately preceding warmup processing_end_ns)/1e9); includes acquisition, processing and between-frame overhead; report separately from 1000/median processing.
timing.percentile: numpy quantile default linear, no outlier removal
timing.pooling: Primary combined concatenates three -5 sessions (5850). Also per exposure and all retained combined; primary macros use only -5 pooled.

separate_session: A fresh Python process and camera reopen for each session, in the listed order. All completed sessions are included.
